slides.title: Introduction to DRF
slides.content:
# Django REST Framework 🔌

Build powerful, flexible Web APIs!

## What you'll learn:
- **Serializers** - Data conversion
- **Views** - API endpoints
- **Routers** - URL generation

## Installation

```bash
pip install djangorestframework
```

```python
# settings.py
INSTALLED_APPS = [
    # ...
    'rest_framework',
]
```

> 💡 **DRF is the standard for building APIs in Django!** Used by companies like Mozilla, Red Hat, Heroku.

slides.title: Serializers
slides.content:
# Serializers 📦

Convert complex data types to JSON.

## ModelSerializer

```python
from rest_framework import serializers
from .models import Article

class ArticleSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    class Meta:
        model = Article
        fields = ['id', 'title', 'content', 'author']
        # Or: fields = '__all__'
```

## Using Serializers

```python
# Serialize (object → JSON)
article = Article.objects.get(pk=1)
serializer = ArticleSerializer(article)
data = serializer.data  # {'id': 1, 'title': '...'}

# Deserialize (JSON → object)
serializer = ArticleSerializer(data=request.data)
if serializer.is_valid():
    serializer.save()
```

slides.title: ViewSets and Routers
slides.content:
# ViewSets & Routers 🛤️

Simplify API creation!

## ViewSet

```python
from rest_framework import viewsets

class ArticleViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    queryset = Article.objects.all()
    serializer_class = ArticleSerializer
```

## Router (Auto URLs)

```python
from rest_framework.routers import DefaultRouter

router = DefaultRouter()
router.register('articles', ArticleViewSet)

# urls.py
urlpatterns = [
    path('api/', include(router.urls)),
]

# Creates:
# GET /api/articles/
# POST /api/articles/
# GET /api/articles/{id}/
# PUT /api/articles/{id}/
# DELETE /api/articles/{id}/
```

> 💡 **One ViewSet + Router = Complete CRUD API!**

slides.title: Summary
slides.content:
# Excellent Work! 🎉

You've learned Django REST Framework!

## Key Concepts
- ✅ **Serializers** - Data conversion
- ✅ **API Views** - Handle requests
- ✅ **Generic Views** - CRUD shortcuts
- ✅ **ViewSets** - All operations in one class
- ✅ **Routers** - Auto URL generation
